item.title: The $1M idea
item.description:
A few days ago, my team and I raised $120k to pursue our dream. Link to heading

A year ago, I never would’ve imagined this.

In the past year I was going through breakup, falling out with my family, lost two jobs, recovering from a motorbike accident, and addicted to some bad habits. All in a foreign country with no connections. Most of which felt like my fault. I was battling my mental health, my sense of identity, and honor.

item.title: How a classroom in Vietnam changed my life
item.description:
How a Classroom in Vietnam Changed My Life Link to heading

The First Day I Almost Quit Link to heading

When I first walked into that classroom in Vietnam, I barely knew a word of Vietnamese and had never taught before. My first lesson was a disaster—kids talking over me, no one paying attention, and me not understanding a thing.

item.title: Building digital license plates for drones at 24
item.description:
It was probably the biggest professional challenge of my career, all as junior engineer. Link to heading

In 2022, I took on a project that would define much of my year: building Remote ID for our drones. For those unfamiliar, Remote ID is the FAA’s new requirement—basically a digital license plate that broadcasts a drone’s identity and location in real-time. Without it, our entire fleet would be grounded. No worries… At that time I was still figuring out how a 401k worked.
